data.name: Ghulam
data.gender_notes: Ghulam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghulama', meaning 'to serve' or 'slave'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes devotion and submission to Allah. The name Ghulam carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghulam usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Servant of Allah, as described in Surah Al-An'am, verse 165.
data.etymology: Ghulam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghulam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.meaning: المتعلّق بالرّب، المولى، العبد المخلّص، المتواضع
in_arabic.long_meaning: غُلام: أصل الكلمة مشتق من الجذر غ-ل-م، يُشير إلى العبد المخلص والمولى، ويزخر بالمعاني الإيجابية في الدين الإسلامي، حيث يشير إلى العبد المطيع للرب، والمخلص من نفسه، ويُعدّ غُلام للرب من خلال الطاعة والخضوع، ويُعتبر غُلام من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم، حيث يُزعم أن الله سبحانه وتعالى يُدعى غُلامًا في بعض الآيات، ويشير هذا الاسم إلى العبودية والإخلاص والتواضع والخضوع للرب، ويحتوي هذا الاسم على معنى العبودية والعطاء، وهو ملك للرب، ويُعتبر غُلام من أسماء النبي محمد صَلّى الله عليه وسلم، ويُشير إلى العبودية والخضوع والتواضع، ويُستخدم غُلام في الإسلام لوصف العبد المخلص والمولى، ويُعتبر غُلام من أهم أسماء الله التي تُستخدم في الإسلام، حيث يُزخر بالمعاني الإيجابية، ويُشير إلى العبودية والإخلاص والتواضع والخضوع للرب.

in_english.name: Ghulam
in_english.meaning: Servant of God, master, slave, humility
in_english.long_meaning: Ghulam is an Arabic name derived from the root G-L-M, referring to a devoted servant of God, a humble and obedient slave, and a person who submits to God's will. The name Ghulam signifies a state of spiritual slavery to God, where the individual surrenders their ego and desires to the divine will. In Islamic tradition, Ghulam is considered one of the beautiful names of God, emphasizing God's role as the Master and the One who owns all creation. The name Ghulam also carries connotations of servitude, humility, and submission to God's authority. In Islamic theology, Ghulam refers to the concept of being a slave of God, where the individual dedicates their life to serving and obeying God's commands. The name Ghulam is often associated with qualities such as devotion, loyalty, and humility, and is considered a noble and virtuous name in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: In certain Islamic communities, the name Ghulam was historically given to enslaved people who converted to Islam. The name signified their submission to their new faith and master, Allah. This historical context conveys a deep sense of loyalty, obedience, and reverence to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ghulam carries a rich spiritual significance in Islam. It serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal in life, which is to be a devoted servant of Allah. The name reflects an inward transformation, emphasizing the importance of humility, submission, and surrender to the Divine Will. By bearing this name, individuals are constantly encouraged to strive towards spiritual growth, self-discipline, and a stronger bond with Allah.
